issues.explanation: Overlapping IssueTicket coverage is duplicated across tests/Feature/IssueTicketTest.php and tests/Feature/Queue/IssueTicketTest.php instead of one suite.
Business-rules text uses called_by while the schema and model use called_by_user_id, a small naming inconsistency.

conventions.evidence: Domain write in app/Actions/IssueTicket.php:32-81, authorization via TicketPolicy + Gate (app/Policies/TicketPolicy.php:35-38, app/Models/Ticket.php:299), reversible migrations (database/migrations/2026_10_29_053421_create_queues_table.php:448-469), deliberate Fillable (app/Models/Queue.php:158, app/Models/Ticket.php:207), docs + CHANGELOG synced (docs/business-rules.md:544-582, docs/database-schema.md, CHANGELOG.md:9)

readability.evidence: Small focused methods issue()/nextCode()/call() with clear names and PHPDoc (app/Actions/IssueTicket.php:39-44, app/Models/Ticket.php:273-296); consistent Laravel style, no dead code

requirements.evidence: IssueTicket locks queue row and re-checks is_active in tx with retry (app/Actions/IssueTicket.php:51-80); Ticket::nextCode uses lazyByIdDesc + /^A\d+$/ + sprintf A%03d for insertion-order, malformed-skip, A999->A1000 (app/Models/Ticket.php:277-288); write-once updating guard and call() with Gate authorize + LogicException (app/Models/Ticket.php:241-260,297-314); migrations unique (queue_id,code) + index (queue_id,status,priority,issued_at)

scope.evidence: Diff only adds queues/tickets models, enums, InactiveQueueException, IssueTicket, TicketPolicy, factories, two migrations, required business-rules/database-schema/CHANGELOG updates and Queue/Ticket tests; no unrelated refactors

security.evidence: Gate::forUser($user)->authorize('call',$this) before mutation and LogicException on non-waiting with stale-row lock+refresh (app/Models/Ticket.php:299-308); priority InvalidArgumentException (app/Actions/IssueTicket.php:47-49); Fillable restricts mass assignment; no unescaped output or secrets

simplicity.evidence: Lean production code (IssueTicket ~60 lines, nextCode ~12 lines, reuses Eloquent/Gate); minor duplication: two overlapping IssueTicket suites (tests/Feature/IssueTicketTest.php vs tests/Feature/Queue/IssueTicketTest.php)

tests.evidence: Queue/IssueTicketTest stale-queue rejection and 3-attempt collision retry (914-960); TicketCallTest member/roles/outsider/once/stale (1045-1118); TicketWriteOnceTest immutable-field matrix and transition checks (1295-1366); TicketCodeTest insertion-order, malformed, deletion-gap (1176-1205)

review.summary: Adds queues/tickets persistence, IssueTicket issuance with locked inactive-check and code-collision retry, per-queue display codes, write-once guard and policy-authorized single Ticket::call, with docs and extensive Pest coverage. Approve as is; only nits are duplicated IssueTicket test suites and a called_by naming inconsistency.
